screen.nirncraft.race_start: Whatever your blood, your story begins in Skyrim, on a cart bound for Helgen.
race.nirncraft.nord.desc: Tall, fair and stubborn as the mountains, the Nords of Skyrim are children of the sky. Cold barely touches them, and they meet every hardship with an axe, a song and a horn of mead.
race.nirncraft.imperial.desc: The people of Cyrodiil built the Empire with law, roads and disciplined legions. Educated and persuasive, they are as at home in a council chamber as on a battlefield, and fortune seems to follow them.
race.nirncraft.breton.desc: The Bretons of High Rock carry elven blood beneath human faces. Magic comes easily to them and slides off them just as easily, which makes them fine mages and finer survivors.
race.nirncraft.redguard.desc: Descended from the sword-singers of lost Yokuda, the Redguards of Hammerfell are the most naturally gifted warriors in Tamriel. Desert life has made them tough, swift and hard to poison.
race.nirncraft.altmer.desc: The tall, golden Altmer of the Summerset Isles think themselves the purest of the elves, and few can match their command of the arcane. They are born with deeper reserves of magicka than any other people.
race.nirncraft.bosmer.desc: The small, quick clanfolk of Valenwood live by the Green Pact and the bow. Unmatched archers and stalkers, they shrug off the poisons and fevers of their forests.
race.nirncraft.dunmer.desc: Ash-skinned and red-eyed, the Dunmer of Morrowind are proud, clannish and dangerous with both blade and spell. Their ancestors still watch over them, and fire holds little terror for them.
race.nirncraft.orsimer.desc: The Orsimer of the Wrothgarian mountains are forged in hard strongholds under Malacath's harsh code. They are tireless warriors and master armorers whose rage in battle is the stuff of legend.
race.nirncraft.khajiit.desc: The cat-folk of Elsweyr are born in many shapes under the moons. Agile, clever and light on their feet, they make deadly thieves, and their claws need no blade.
race.nirncraft.argonian.desc: The reptilian Saxhleel of Black Marsh are bound to the mysterious Hist trees. At home in the swamp and under the water, they resist the diseases and poisons that kill outsiders.
race.nirncraft.maormer.desc: The Maormer sail from the storm-wrapped isles of Pyandonea, sworn enemies of Summerset. Their translucent skin takes on the colours around them, they breathe the sea as easily as air, and they call down lightning on their foes.
race.nirncraft.reachman.desc: The Reachfolk of Skyrim's western crags are of Breton blood but answer to no king. They keep the old gods and older pacts with hagravens, and their bravest warriors trade their hearts for living briars.
race.nirncraft.ohmes_raht.desc: Born under certain moons, the Ohmes-raht look almost like Wood Elves, save for their tails, eyes and painted fur-patterns. They move easily among men and mer, charming and trading where other Khajiit are turned away.
race.nirncraft.lilmothiit.desc: The fox-folk of Black Marsh were few even in their days of glory, nomads and traders of the southern coast. Quick, nimble and full of tricks, they leap where others climb and vanish where others hide.
race.nirncraft.imga.desc: The great apes of Valenwood admire the High Elves above all things and copy their manners, dress and titles with solemn devotion. Beneath the courtesy lies the strength to tear a gate from its hinges.
race.nirncraft.tsaesci.desc: The golden serpent-folk of Akavir devoured or enslaved their neighbours and once came to Tamriel's shores at the head of an army. Tall, cold-eyed and graceful, they are sword-masters, sorcerers and climbers, and their bite carries venom.
race.nirncraft.ka_po_tun.desc: The tiger-folk of Akavir's steppes have warred against the serpents for ages and dream of becoming dragons themselves. Huge and fearless, they fight with claw and great blade, and their roar breaks the nerve of their enemies.
race.nirncraft.tang_mo.desc: The monkey-folk of Akavir's thousand isles are brave, simple and kind, and come in a bewildering variety; some, it is said, with more arms than two. Nothing matches them for speed, climbing and leaping.
race.nirncraft.atmoran.desc: Out of frozen Atmora came the first men to settle Skyrim, the forefathers of the Nords. Theirs was an age when the Voice was spoken freely, and the old blood still finds the Thu'um easier than breath.
race.nirncraft.falmer.desc: Before the Dwemer's betrayal blinded and twisted them, the Snow Elves were a bright and learned people of Skyrim, priests of the sun and masters of light magic. Only a rare few of the old line endure.
race.nirncraft.dwemer.desc: The Deep Elves reasoned their way into the secrets of the world and built cities of brass and stone that still hum beneath the earth. One day they all vanished. You are, impossibly, one of them, and their machines still know your tone.
race.nirncraft.ayleid.desc: The Heartland High Elves ruled Cyrodiil from the White-Gold Tower, drawing starlight into welkynd stones. Their empire fell long ago, but their sorcery remains among the most potent ever known.
race.nirncraft.kothringi.desc: The gentle, silver-skinned river folk of Black Marsh were all but wiped out by the Knahaten Flu. Those who remain are untouched by any sickness, and their mirror-bright skin can dazzle a foe.
race.nirncraft.passive.climbing: Climbs walls (hold Jump against a wall)
race.nirncraft.passive.thuum: Thu'um affinity: the Voice recovers %s%% faster
power.nirncraft.adrenaline_rush.desc: Stamina regenerates ten times faster for 60 seconds.
power.nirncraft.ancestors_wrath.desc: Surrounds you in fire for 60 seconds, burning anyone who comes close.
power.nirncraft.battle_cry.desc: Nearby enemies flee in terror and are weakened for 30 seconds.
power.nirncraft.berserker_rage.desc: Deal double damage and take half damage for 60 seconds.
power.nirncraft.command_animal.desc: Nearby animals turn friendly and heal for a minute.
power.nirncraft.dragonskin.desc: For 60 seconds, half of every hostile spell is absorbed as magicka.
power.nirncraft.highborn.desc: Magicka regenerates 25 times faster for 60 seconds.
power.nirncraft.histskin.desc: Health regenerates ten times faster for 60 seconds.
power.nirncraft.night_eye.desc: See in the dark for 60 seconds (can be used often).
power.nirncraft.chameleon_skin.desc: Your skin takes the colours around you: invisible for 60 seconds, swimming like a dolphin and breathing water.
power.nirncraft.briarheart.desc: The briar in your chest wakes: for 60 seconds you hit harder, take less damage, regenerate and shrug off blows.
power.nirncraft.moon_shadow.desc: Slip from sight for 30 seconds and see in the dark for a minute; nearby foes lose track of you.
power.nirncraft.foxfire_ruse.desc: Nearby enemies forget you for 20 seconds while you vanish and dash away.
power.nirncraft.noble_challenge.desc: A thunderous challenge: nearby enemies are cowed and slowed for 30 seconds while you grow stronger and tougher.
power.nirncraft.serpent_gaze.desc: Your cold stare paralyses nearby enemies for 6 seconds and weakens them.
power.nirncraft.tiger_roar.desc: A roar that hurls back and wounds nearby enemies, who flee for 10 seconds and stay weakened.
power.nirncraft.thousand_hands.desc: For 60 seconds you move, strike and work with a blur of hands.
power.nirncraft.voice_of_atmora.desc: Your Voice is ready again at once, and the old cold hardens you for 60 seconds.
power.nirncraft.auriels_dawn.desc: A burst of sunlight burns the undead around you and blinds your enemies, and heals you.
power.nirncraft.tonal_resonance.desc: Dwemer automatons take you for one of their makers and leave you alone for 2 minutes.
power.nirncraft.welkynd_radiance.desc: Your magicka is restored at once, and starlight marks and dazzles nearby enemies.
power.nirncraft.quicksilver_skin.desc: Your silver skin hardens for 60 seconds and flashes, blinding enemies close to you.
